notes: MGAIC is an industry-funded research consortium administered by the MIT Schwarzman College of Computing, not a PI-led lab itself -- it funds cross-departmental projects (seen on the homepage: Daron Acemoglu/Economics, Jacob Andreas/EECS and Asuman Ozdaglar/EECS on one project; Eric Klopfer/CMS-Writing and Cynthia Breazeal/Media Lab on another). Those PIs' primary labs belong in their home department's source file, not here, so this file is deliberately empty per the project's cross-cutting-hub convention. General contact: mitgenai@mit.edu. No member/people directory page exists on the site.
